## Šiaulių bankas — Company.id 15831

Catalog metadata (unchanged):

```json
{
  "countryCode": "LT",
  "fullTitle": "Siauliu bankas",
  "id": 15831,
  "title": "\u0160iauli\u0173 bankas",
  "url": "sb.lt"
}
```

Frozen base commit: `fe29fbc1291b8842ed201261408a3bc690875b55`. Checked: `2026-10-04T06:13:11.154447Z`.

### Exact versions and source

- Current/base SVG: [base.svg](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/e89ce2b8933708dbbe9c0448ce6f11dddfa52af9/review-materials/15831/base.svg) — SHA-256 `6d9c3b17c69c782de5bd17a05a91c99c6e88b7a044b618f78c3ee58d29c6913a`.
- Fetched source SVG: [source.svg](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/e89ce2b8933708dbbe9c0448ce6f11dddfa52af9/review-materials/15831/source.svg) — SHA-256 `fd05ff8208ae8a235148babf9f6bcf119a6952bf1f5d7fa827beb07563b3a911`.
- Proposed final SVG: [final.svg](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/e89ce2b8933708dbbe9c0448ce6f11dddfa52af9/review-materials/15831/final.svg) — SHA-256 `fe60b14504a4ba5d4d6fe8f0d97d831ab43dbacd1dc473c84d346d3992850248`.
- Generated VectorDrawable XML: [final.xml](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/e89ce2b8933708dbbe9c0448ce6f11dddfa52af9/review-materials/15831/final.xml) — SHA-256 `80f2fcdfe8dc1c1012078f4d37e8b9e0f81fba1cf81861fc4d9f37ac794b1345`.
- Exact base-to-final changes: [candidate.diff](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/e89ce2b8933708dbbe9c0448ce6f11dddfa52af9/review-materials/15831/candidate.diff).
- Source page: [https://www.artea.lt/favicon.svg](https://www.artea.lt/favicon.svg).
- Source asset: [https://www.artea.lt/favicon.svg](https://www.artea.lt/favicon.svg).

### Evidence and judgment

- official checked 2026-10-04T05:51:33Z: [https://www.artea.lt/favicon.svg](https://www.artea.lt/favicon.svg); asset [https://www.artea.lt/favicon.svg](https://www.artea.lt/favicon.svg). Official artea.lt \(renamed bank\) serves favicon.svg: 600x600 viewBox, single navy #071844 path forming the standalone Artea geometric mark without lettering; geometry matches the mark inside official lockups \(cdn.artea.lt/mainweb/logo.svg, uploads/media/67d827529218b/artea-logo-dark.svg — both lockups rejected for lettering\). favicon.svg resolves at site root; homepage HTML has no \<link rel=icon\> \(labeled probe\). (independence group: artea.lt official assets).
- third-party checked 2026-10-04T05:49:58Z: [https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/03/31/](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/03/31/). GlobeNewswire notice \(2025-03-31\) and artea.lt rebrand FAQ confirm Šiaulių bankas renamed to Artea bankas effective 2025-05-05; same legal entity continuing. (independence group: GlobeNewswire release and artea.lt FAQ).
- Independent evidence: Primary: bank's own artea.lt assets; rename corroborated by independent GlobeNewswire release; rejected lockups are distinct official files, not evidence copies..
- Identity: confirmed — Mark served by the renamed bank's own domain \(sb.lt/Šiaulių bankas → artea.lt\); rename of the same legal entity confirmed by official FAQ and press release..
- Currency: confirmed — Observed live 2026-10-04 on the bank's official properties; former wordmark no longer used by the bank..
- Variant: confirmed — Standalone geometric mark without lettering \(favicon.svg\), matching the mark component of the official lockups..
- Uncertainty: Catalog record title remains 'Šiaulių bankas' while the current brand is Artea bankas; icon update reflects the evidenced rename of the same bank, metadata titles are out of scope for the icon change..

Rationale: Šiaulių bankas renamed to Artea bankas effective 2025-05-05 \(official FAQ, GlobeNewswire\); the accepted icon is the former lowercase wordmark while the bank's current standalone mark is the Artea geometric mark served as the official favicon.svg — evidenced rename update of the same bank..
Role: Standalone current bank mark \(Artea geometric mark, navy #071844\), transparent background.; variant: Current official standalone mark \(favicon.svg at artea.lt site root\); matches the mark component of the official lockups, which are rejected for lettering..
Visible difference: Base is the former 'šiaulių bankas' SB monogram; final is the current Artea geometric mark — evidenced rename of the same legal entity, not a successor substitution..
Details: Single navy path renders cleanly: angular 'a'-like mark with counter hole preserved as true transparency; no fill-in, no distortion in 240px renders.. Proportions: Source used as-is: 600x600 standalone mark, no transforms, no backing added \(suitable transparent standalone mark\); centered by the source viewBox with even margins..

Source-to-final transformations:
- No geometric transformation; source mark used unchanged.
- SVGO 4.1.0 with frozen config sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e: 989 -\> 829 bytes; optimized output selected after working-vs-optimized comparison showed identical rendering.

### Light and dark before/after

![Before and after — light background](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/e89ce2b8933708dbbe9c0448ce6f11dddfa52af9/review-materials/15831/comparison-light.png?raw=true)

![Before and after — dark background](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/e89ce2b8933708dbbe9c0448ce6f11dddfa52af9/review-materials/15831/comparison-dark.png?raw=true)

### Render checks and limits

Desktop renderer recorded: `offscreen CPU Skia/painterResource` at `2026-10-04T06:11:21.208013216Z`. Source/final: Original 600x600 SVG inspected and independently rasterized: single authored navy path; internal transparency of the counter preserved in the final; source color unchanged.; base/final and rendering: Exact base/final pairs on both themes: base former SB monogram; final Artea mark. On dark theme the navy mark is lower-contrast but its silhouette and counter remain clearly readable; official current color retained rather than recolored.

- android-native: not-tested (available: false) — No Android system images installed; AVD creation requires downloads outside this run..
- ios-compose: not-tested (available: false) — No iOS tooling in this environment..
